summary: TC Energy Corp. filed its Quarterly Report on Form 6-K for the period ended March 31, 2026, which includes MD&A, financial statements, and certifications. This is a routine periodic filing (Q1 earnings) by a foreign private issuer to satisfy continuous disclosure obligations under U.S. securities laws. It does not announce any M&A, activist campaign, tender offer, going-private transaction, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, spin-off, or other special situation event. The explanatory note references an October 2024 spinoff of Liquids Pipelines into South Bow Corp., but that past event is not the subject of this filing. There are no deal terms, no board recommendation, and no risk-arb angle to analyze.
